question: How much of the China-shipped HS 3504, 2106.10 and 1109 tonnage (about 54,000 t in 2025) goes to food rather than feed, and to which buyers?
why_it_matters: China's HS 3504 unit value (USD 0.89 to 1.03/kg) is too low for food-grade isolates, so the food market for plant protein may be much smaller than trade totals suggest; this sizes the addressable B2B market for a domestic ingredient
cheapest_way_to_close: Buy 2024 to 2025 Vietnamese customs declaration-level data (8-digit code, goods description, importer) from a trade-data vendor, or request a tabulation from the customs statistics unit
owner_org_to_ask: General Department of Customs (statistics); commercial trade-data vendors

question: Which firms import soy protein isolate, TVP and gluten into Vietnam, and in what tonnage each?
why_it_matters: Names the real first customers and the distributors who control SME access
cheapest_way_to_close: Same declaration-level dataset; cross-check with distributor interviews (VMC Group, Brenntag Vietnam, Barentz Vietnam)

question: What inclusion rates and annual tonnages of soy protein, gluten, milk protein and egg white do Vissan, Masan MEATLife, CJ and Cholimex use?
why_it_matters: Converts label presence (31% of Vissan formulations) into tonnes and spend
cheapest_way_to_close: Short structured interview with R&D or purchasing managers using the supply study founder questionnaire
owner_org_to_ask: Vissan R&D; Masan MEATLife; CJ Foods Vietnam; Cholimex Food

question: How long does ingredient qualification take (sample, pilot, line trial, supplier audit, listing) at a large Vietnamese processor, and what documents are required?
why_it_matters: Sets the time to first revenue for any domestic or novel ingredient
cheapest_way_to_close: Interviews at Fi Vietnam or through the Vietnam Association of Food Science and Technology; ask for supplier approval checklists
owner_org_to_ask: Vinamilk QA; Acecook QA; Vissan QA; VAFoST

question: At what price and specification would Vinamilk, Vinasoy or Nutifood trial a Vietnamese rice or mung bean protein isolate instead of imported pea protein?
why_it_matters: Tests the most promising pull for a domestic plant-protein isolate
cheapest_way_to_close: Send specification sheet and samples; run a price-point interview with 5 to 10 R&D buyers

question: What is Vietnam's total industrial processed-meat output (t per year) by product type?
why_it_matters: Needed to scale meat-extender demand beyond one company
cheapest_way_to_close: NSO industrial production statistics by product code; MOIT; company filings (Vissan, Masan MEATLife, CAN)
owner_org_to_ask: National Statistics Office; Ministry of Industry and Trade

question: Where does Vinamilk source its pea protein, and how much does it buy?
why_it_matters: Measures the only confirmed large non-soy isolate demand
cheapest_way_to_close: Customs declarations; supplier interview; Vinamilk procurement

question: Do instant-noodle makers (Acecook, Masan Consumer, Uniben, Asia Foods) plan protein-fortified lines?
why_it_matters: 8.2 billion servings a year; a small protein increment per pack would be a large ingredient volume
cheapest_way_to_close: Interview Acecook R&D; audit labels of high-protein noodle launches in Japan and Korea by the same groups

question: What protein ingredients do Duc Viet, Le Gia, Uniben, Asia Foods, TH, IDP and FrieslandCampina Vietnam use, and have they made statements on plant protein?
why_it_matters: Gaps in this wave's buyer map because web search was unavailable
cheapest_way_to_close: Retail label audit (extend FORM-01 method) and company websites

question: How much food-grade whey, WPC and lactose go to infant formula versus feed, and at what specification?
why_it_matters: Sizes the precision-fermentation dairy opportunity against real specifications
cheapest_way_to_close: USDA FAS Dairy and Products Annual; customs declarations; formula makers
owner_org_to_ask: USDA FAS Hanoi; infant formula makers

question: Will precision-fermented proteins be treated as GMO food ingredients under the new Food Safety Law and Decree 43/2026, and what does that mean for dairy buyers' labels?
why_it_matters: Buyers such as Vinamilk market 'non-GMO'; a GMO label could block uptake regardless of price
cheapest_way_to_close: Legal review after the October to November 2026 National Assembly session
owner_org_to_ask: Vietnam Food Administration (Ministry of Health); law firms

question: Is the next Fi Vietnam in May 2027 (USDA) or May 2028 (organiser site)?
why_it_matters: Timing of the main ingredient trade fair for first-customer meetings

question: Do chay exporters require Halal, Kosher or non-GMO certificates from ingredient suppliers, and which certifiers?
why_it_matters: A domestic TVP must carry the certificates its export customers need
cheapest_way_to_close: Interview Au Lac and An Nhien export managers
